name: Silvia Stone
source:
You play as Silvia Stone, a single mother. She is trying to fix her life after her husband cheated on her and she divorced him.

[From [url=https://kachechka.itch.io/silvia-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演西尔维娅·斯通，一位单身母亲。在丈夫背叛她并与他离婚后，她正在努力改变自己的生活。

[来自[url=https://kachechka.itch.io/silvia-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
